packageRules.description: Patch/minor devDependencies merge themselves once the required checks pass (0.x excluded: minors there may break)
Patch/minor devDependencies (0.x excluded, they stay separate) come as one weekly PR: fewer PRs, fewer CI runs. The groups below (tauri, nx, playwright) still win for their packages
Tauri JS packages and Rust crates must stay on matching versions
Nx is upgraded with `nx migrate` (it rewrites code); Renovate only flags it on the Dependency Dashboard

playwright and @playwright/test must resolve to one version: they share the downloaded browsers. Serenity/JS rides along: @serenity-js/playwright pins its playwright-core peer to one minor (~1.x), so a Playwright minor needs the matching Serenity/JS release in the same PR
pnpm is pinned both in package.json packageManager and in the workflows' pnpm/action-setup version; bump both in one PR
Hold WebdriverIO at 9 until @serenity-js/webdriverio supports 10 (its peer range is ^9; v10's default strictSelectors makes Serenity's isPresent() throw on a missing element)
expect-webdriverio 8 needs webdriverio ^10 (held above); 7.x is the last line for webdriverio 9. Lift together with the WebdriverIO hold

Hold TypeScript at 6 until typescript-eslint (peer typescript <6.1.0 in 8.73) and Nx support 7: TypeScript 7 (native) lacks the JS API they call (Nx's @nx/js/typescript plugin fails with 'tsModule.readConfigFile is not a function', #243)

Hold ESLint at 9 until eslint-plugin-react (loaded by Nx's flat/react config; peer eslint up to ^9.7) supports 10: ESLint 10 removed context.getFilename() and the plugin's rules fail to load (#244). Moving to 10 also turns on preserve-caught-error, which flags our code
